description: This PHP class defines a Drupal migration source plugin for extracting field instance configurations per view mode from Drupal 6 database, specifically for the 'field' module.

classes.name: FieldInstancePerViewMode
classes.description: A Drupal migration source plugin class for extracting field instance configurations per view mode from Drupal 6 database.

methods.name: initializeIterator
methods.description: Initializes the data iterator by querying the database and processing field instance rows for each view mode.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to fetch field instance data.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields provided by this source plugin.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the primary key fields for the data being migrated.
